name: @dawnchat/assistant-workspace
// workspace purpose: Assistant source workspace for SDK packages and assistant templates. Runtime plugin installs still happen after backend rewrite in user plugin directories.

scripts.build:sdk: bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk build
scripts.verify:sdk: bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core typecheck && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk test && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk build
scripts.build:templates: bun run --cwd ../official-plugins/desktop-ai-assistant/_ir/frontend/web-src build && bun run --cwd ../official-plugins/web-ai-assistant/web-src build
scripts.verify:templates: bun run verify:sdk && bun run --cwd ../official-plugins/desktop-ai-assistant/_ir/frontend/web-src verify && bun run --cwd ../official-plugins/web-ai-assistant/web-src verify
